name: (05) Thaumaturgy (Hands of Destruction) — 3 Advanced — Turn to Dust

system.description:
Amplifying decay to a horrific speed, the sorcerer withers a victim to a pile of dust; mortals collapse to putrefied remains almost instantly.

Get a firm grip on your victim with a Physical Challenge, then for each Physical Trait you expend afterward the subject ages ten years. A mortal aged more than 50 years dies instantly, reduced to liquefied tissue and crumbling bone; a vampire aged 50 years or more gains the Negative Trait Repugnant for the rest of the evening but suffers no actual physical harm. Turn to Dust functions only on living or undead targets; use Decay on inanimate ones. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Instant, cumulative effect permanent on mortals
